note: Failures are exact native job observations. Family groupings are analyst hypotheses. This read-only projection is not an authenticated EVERRED ledger event nor a live GitHub census.

families.title: EVERRED Python formatting
families.summary: Python 3.10 and 3.12 on both PRs reject Black formatting. Shared model_readiness/metrics files recur; #1955 also introduces TOP21 files.
families.justification: Four native jobs fail the same formatter check; repeated paths justify one coordinated source-owner investigation but do not prove one causal defect.
families.remediation: Use pinned Black 26.10.1/isort 9.0.2 against current main; format only affected files, maintain py310 compatibility, and compare shared versus introduced paths.
families.dov: At successor SHA, both Python-version formatter checks and isort pass; affected-file receipts and independent review verified.

families.title: Broad coverage below 75%
families.summary: Both broad CI reports: 30,600 statements, 13,858 missed, 8,242 branches, combined 53.58%; requirement 75%. #1954 has a separate 60/84 changed-line report (71%).
families.justification: Same broad numerator/denominator reported on distinct PRs implies inherited repository-wide coverage debt is plausible. Changed-line 71% must never be substituted for 53.58% broad.
families.remediation: Extract full coverage JSON/XML under one configuration and source SHA; prioritize high-denominator modules with attributed uncovered lines, add tests without moving thresholds.
families.dov: New current-main JSON with eligible+covered lines/branches and matching config digest; broad threshold 75% met or reported RED; changed-line coverage separately measured.

observations.detail: TOTAL 30,600 statements / 13,858 missed / 8,242 branches; 53.58% combined; diff-cover 60/84 = 71%.
Same combined 53.58%, 75% required; diff-cover has no measurable source lines in that diff.

families.title: Safety scanner exit 64
families.summary: Safety exits 64 on both PRs. The parallel Bandit scan reports 6,527 raw findings and zero parse errors, not a comparable finding delta.
families.justification: Scanner failure is independent from formatter and coverage checks. Bandit raw volume is a census; it is not 6,527 new vulnerabilities or 6,527 confirmed causes.
families.remediation: Retrieve Safety JSON/stderr and scanner versions, classify exit 64 and advisory/config/license causes, rerun comparable scan; fingerprint Bandit against same base/config.
families.dov: Safety terminal report and explicit security reviewer disposition; comparable Bandit opened/resolved/net and config digest. No security waivers.

observations.detail: Safety exit 64; Bandit raw 6,527 findings, parse errors 0.

families.title: A10 tender-material guard
families.summary: The a10 guard detects two files resembling tender material on #1954. The inspected summary does not establish sensitivity or disclose filenames.
families.justification: Potential protected material requires human confidentiality review; do not auto-allowlist based solely on a common file signature.
families.remediation: Review the guard artifact in authorized context, determine exact files and exposure; move sensitive material to private storage or document approved hashes through a governed review.
families.dov: Authorized reviewer records disposition, historical exposure assessment where applicable, and passing guard on the exact successor SHA.

observations.detail: Two files flagged as tender-like; paths not confirmed in available summary.

families.title: TOP21 Markdownlint defects
families.summary: Markdownlint reports MD031 at line 12 (fence separation) and MD032 at line 36 (list separation) in TOP21_ROLLOUT_CONTRACT.md.
families.justification: Exact file, rules and line numbers are present in native job logs; repair is directly attributable to the TOP21 documentation.
families.remediation: Add blank lines around fenced Bash block and list. Keep requirements semantics unchanged; run same markdownlint config.
families.dov: MD031 and MD032 checks pass in new exact-head docs lint; file diff contains only spacing changes.

families.title: Broad code-quality roots
families.summary: Code Quality Checks fail on both PRs. A full-scan Black/isort gate reports red; additional historical lint output requires separate new-debt attribution.
families.justification: This broader gate must not be automatically marked repaired by the EVERRED-only formatting work. Per-tool full scans and base/PR ratchets differ.
families.remediation: Fingerprint Black/isort/Flake8/Pylint by path/rule and exact configuration, separate inherited debt from introduced lines, then assign disjoint workers.
families.dov: Independent per-tool full scan or accepted ratchet receipts match exact SHA and review policy without bypasses.

observations.detail: Required BLACK and ISORT full scan failed; broad lint debt also present.
Code quality native job red; specific scanner/ratchet reconciliation still required.

families.title: Full Red Proof rollup
families.summary: Full Red Proof Summary fails because lint/format, coverage and security remain red.
families.justification: One aggregate red is a dependency outcome, not proof of another independent defect. Keep references but avoid duplicate BD debt totals.
families.remediation: Re-evaluate rollup only after producer checks complete; retain all required checks.
families.dov: All referenced producer receipts terminal and admissible; rollup recomputes to PASS at the same SHA.

observations.detail: Aggregate gate fails while producer checks remain red.

families.title: Feedback evaluator cancellations
families.summary: Both PRs show cancelled PR Feedback Gate Evaluator executions and failed feedback gates; cancelling alone does not prove causality.
families.justification: High-frequency evaluator reruns can amplify queue pressure. A cancelled evaluator must never be promoted to a passing required gate.
families.remediation: Group by PR head, run attempt, trigger and concurrency key; coalesce repeated triggers while preserving exact-head required checks.
families.dov: Terminal canonical feedback gate with source-bound producer receipts and no stale/skipped required evidence.
